svg.text: SCALE 1:25 · BOOKCASE · PANEL FOR PAINTING · WINDOW
COUNTER TOP LEVEL WITH THE WINDOW SILL
CUT AT 1200 · SCALE 1:25 · ROOM BELOW, WALL ABOVE
HARD INTO THE CORNER — NO RETURN ON THE RIGHT
Wall 16 ft wide, ceiling 9 ft (owner's measure).
Window measured: 4 ft wide, 5 ft 5 in tall,
sill 2 ft 3 in (686), hard into the right corner.
Counter top set to the sill at 686 — this datum
runs on round to the right wall rail.
Ref. 1 — fluted pilasters, moulded painting panel.
Ref. 3 — band panels over every bay, twin
sconces, pedestals stepping forward, no arch.
Cupboards under all three bays. Solid teak.
Gold only on handles and sconces.
6 — datum moved to 2 ft 3 in (686), window measured
